en: For the conductor; of the sons of Korach; a song.
You favored, Havayah, Your land; You returned the captivity of Yackov.

he: נָ֭שָׂאתָ עֲוֺ֣ן עַמֶּ֑ךָ כִּסִּ֖יתָ כׇל־חַטָּאתָ֣ם סֶֽלָה׃
en: You bore the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah.
You gathered all Your wrath; You turned from the fierceness of Your anger.

he: שׁ֭וּבֵנוּ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֑נוּ וְהָפֵ֖ר כַּעַסְךָ֣ עִמָּֽנוּ׃
en: Return us, Elokei of our salvation; and annul Your anger with us.

he: הַלְעוֹלָ֥ם תֶּאֱנַף־בָּ֑נוּ תִּמְשֹׁ֥ךְ אַ֝פְּךָ֗ לְדֹ֣ר וָדֹֽר׃
en: Will You be angry with us forever? Will You draw out Your anger to generation and generation?
Will You not return and revive us, that Your people may rejoice in You?
Show us, Havayah, Your kindness; and grant us Your salvation.

he: אֶשְׁמְעָ֗ה מַה־יְדַבֵּר֮ הָאֵ֢ל ׀ יְ֫הֹוָ֥ה כִּ֤י ׀ יְדַבֵּ֬ר שָׁל֗וֹם אֶל־עַמּ֥וֹ וְאֶל־חֲסִידָ֑יו וְאַל־יָשׁ֥וּבוּ לְכִסְלָֽה׃
en: I shall hear what the El, Havayah, shall speak; for He shall speak peace to His people and to His pious ones — but let them not return to folly.

he: אַ֤ךְ קָר֣וֹב לִירֵאָ֣יו יִשְׁע֑וֹ לִשְׁכֹּ֖ן כָּב֣וֹד בְּאַרְצֵֽנוּ׃
en: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that glory may dwell in our land.
Kindness and truth have met; righteousness and peace have kissed.

he: אֱ֭מֶת מֵאֶ֣רֶץ תִּצְמָ֑ח וְ֝צֶ֗דֶק מִשָּׁמַ֥יִם נִשְׁקָֽף׃
en: Truth shall sprout from the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

he: גַּם־יְ֭הֹוָה יִתֵּ֣ן הַטּ֑וֹב וְ֝אַרְצֵ֗נוּ תִּתֵּ֥ן יְבוּלָֽהּ׃
en: Havayah too shall give the good; and our land shall give its produce.

he: צֶ֭דֶק לְפָנָ֣יו יְהַלֵּ֑ךְ וְיָשֵׂ֖ם לְדֶ֣רֶךְ פְּעָמָֽיו׃ {פ}
en: Righteousness shall walk before Him; and He shall set His footsteps to the way.
